|os = {{Name|Fishing Treasure Chest}}{{Name|Artifact Trove|3.6%}} |dr = {{Name|Flute Block}} |sellprice = 100 }} The '''Bone Flute''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] in [[the Mountain]]s, [[Cindersap Forest]], or [[Pelican Town]], or from [[Fishing#Treasure Chests|Fishing Treasure Chests]] or [[Artifact Trove]]s. ==Donation== Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]]. After donating at least 2 other [[artifacts]], donation of the Bone Flute rewards the player with a [[Flute Block]]. ==Bone Mill== The Bone Flute can be turned into [[Quality Fertilizer]], [[Speed-Gro]], [[Deluxe Speed-Gro]] or [[Tree Fertilizer]] in the [[Bone Mill]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Dwarf,Penny,Abigail |dislike=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Tailoring== The Bone Flute is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Blue Long Vest]]. [[File:Shirt242.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *[[Quests#Fragments of the past|"Fragments of the past"]]: [[Gunther]] may make a request on the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] for 100 of any combination of bone items that must be gathered while the quest is active. You have 7 days to complete the quest. The reward is {{Price|3500}} and the [[Bone Mill]] recipe. ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.4|Added [[Artifact Trove]] as a source. Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.5|[[Artifacts]] are now liked by the [[Dwarf]] and [[Penny]], disliked by all other NPCs.}} {{History|1.6|Bone Flute is now liked by Abigail.
